grammar.title: 语法知识 一般过去时&双宾语
lines: 5 一般过去时通常表示完全发生在过去的而现在 已经结束 的事件与现在无关(以前是这样而现在不了)。它通常指动作 何时发生 ，而 不指 动作 持续 多久(与现在完成时的差别：现在完成发生在过去而与现在 有关 并 持续 )。 句型对比 直接宾语和间接宾语 单词位置: 在英语里的处理方式为：谁短谁靠前（礼让弱小原则），如果【直接宾语(物)】在【间接宾语(人)】的前面时须加“to sb. ⇒ I sent a gift to him .” （表示动作对...做） 或“for sb. ⇒ I made a cake for him .” （表示动作为...而做） 哪些及物动词 （vt.） 能接双宾语？ 常用可以接双宾语的动词：send , teach, lend, give, ask, tell, offer,cook, buy, get, make, write, bring, show ... 双宾语动词 + sb. + sth. = 双宾语动词 + sth. + to / for + sb. 什么时候用For、To? For 关乎利益，To 关乎观点 § 可以翻译为 "给"、"替"、"为" 的，就用 "for" 与“利益”有关；如果只能翻译为 "给" 的，就用 "to" 与“目的、观点”有关。
主语 + v. 过去式 (did) 主语 + was/were + 非动词

I went to the park yesterday. 我昨天去的(言外：今天没去) She ate an apple this morning. 早上吃的(言外：现在没吃) We played basketball last night. 昨晚打球(言外：今天没打) She had a boyfriend. 她以前有一个男朋友。(言外：现在没有) Tom was a student. 汤姆以前是学生。(言外：现在不是) It was my aunt Lucy. The play was very interesting.
句型 Be 动词 (过去式) 动词过去式 三单
过去式 You were happy. They had a meeting. She was Chinese.
否定句 You were not happy. They did not have a meeting. She was not Chinese.
一般疑问句 Were you happy? Did they have a meeting? Was she a Chinese?
特殊疑问句 How were you? What did they do ? Who was she?
主谓 间接宾语 （动作目标，动作是谁做的或为谁做的，通常是人） 直接宾语 （表示动作结果，动作所涉及的事物）
I gave him a book.
I bought her a present.
give sb. sth. give sth. to sb
双宾语通常情况一个是人，一个是物。物永远是 直接宾语 ，人则为 间接宾语 ！
Give her the key. Give the key to her.
通过意思去判断。上面提到双宾语直接宾语是物，间接宾语为人。
eat? 吃直接宾语(✓)，吃间接宾语？？？(×)
动词 直接宾语 例子
send a letter I sent a letter to my friend .
teach how to write My teacher taught me how to write .
lend my book I lent my friend my book.
give a present I gave my friend a present.
ask for help I asked my friend for help.
tell a joke I told my friend a joke.
offer a ride I offered my friend a ride.
cook dinner My mom cooked me dinner.
buy a gift I bought my friend a gift.
get a cup of coffee I got my friend a cup of coffee.
make a cake My mom made me a cake.
write a letter I wrote my friend a letter.
bring a book I brought my friend a book.
show my new car I showed my friend my new car.
to 动词向对方给的方向 for 动词为了什么目的
He lent me a book. = He lent a book to me. 他借给了我一本书/他借了一本书给我。 I cooked him a meal. = I cooked a meal for him. 我为他做了一餐(目的是为了给他做饭)。
给某人做某事 帮某人一个忙 do sb. a favor
当间接宾语（人）在直接宾语（物）后时，间接宾语（人）前必须加 "to" （对...而言） 或 "for" （为...而做）

I did my homework. 主谓宾 I did my homework for my teacher. 主谓双宾 I did my homework for my parents. I did the dishes for my mom. I did the laundry for my dad. I did the yard work for my brother. Can you do me a favor? = Can you do a favor for me ? Can you help me with this ? Do me a favor please. 帮我一个忙。 Can I do something for you ? 我可以帮你做点什么？ Can I order something for you ? 我可以帮你点什么吗？ Can I buy you a bottle of beer? 我可以给你买瓶啤酒吗？(请你喝杯酒)

lines: 5 不规则动词的变化 § 每日习语 stay out of it 置身事外；不插手；不卷入是非
中考真题 高考真题

Paul and I played tennis yesterday . He did much better than I. They invited her to the party, so she was very happy. The three of us travelled around Europe for about a month last summer . Did you ask Sophia for help? I didn't need to. I managed perfectly well on my own. Kevin, you look worried. Anything wrong? Well, I took a test and I' m waiting for the result.
